newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ajinomoto to hold news conference on arrest report.
newsitem.headline: Ajinomoto to hold news conference on arrest report.

text.p: Ajinomoto Co Inc said on Tuesday that its managing director Tsuyoshi Shimizu would hold a news conference at 6 p.m. (0900 GMT) at its headquarters on news reports that one of its officials has been arrested.
But it declined to confirm the reports that police have arrested an Ajinomoto official over suspected payments to "sokaiya" racketeers in violation of Japan's commercial law.
A police spokesman also declined to comment on the reported arrest.

However, Ajinomoto, a manufacturer of foodstuffs and seasonings, confirmed that one of its officials was being investigated by police over suspected payments of several million yen of Ajinomoto money to the sokaiya racketeers.
Sokaiya extort money from companies by threatening to disturb shareholders' meetings. Japanese law has prohibited such payoffs since 1982.

In June last year, police arrested a former executive and two officials of Takashimaya Co Ltd, a prestigious Japanese department store, on suspicion of paying money to sokaiya to ensure that a Takashimaya shareholders' meeting in May 1995 went smoothly.
The former officials pleaded guilty to the charges last November.
